summary: Performed the formal Stage 3 Readiness Certification act GPC6C-001 v1.0 itself binds -- the first actual certification act under the now-verified GPC6C-001 (142H) -- evaluating GPC6R-001 v1.0's obligation set (GPC6R-REQ-001 through GPC6R-REQ-073) against current repository state and evidence, not prior-phase narrative. Independently re-checked all five certification preconditions (subject-identity, readiness-verification, readiness-contract-freeze, evidence-package-existence, documentation-consistency); assembled and validated the complete seven-category PGP-001 Section 8.2 evidence package; performed provenance/integrity validation via direct git log and file-read spot-checks (not accepted from any prior phase's narrative); assessed all fourteen GPC6C-001 certification dimensions (governance conformity, contract conformity, architectural fidelity, evidence completeness, evidence quality, provenance integrity, traceability, reproducibility, responsibility conformity, lifecycle-boundary preservation, authority-boundary preservation, runtime-boundary preservation, implementation-boundary preservation, risk-control sufficiency, compatibility), each reaching an independently-confirmed Satisfied disposition against current repository state; performed a seventeen-scenario adversarial review (incomplete/stale/substituted/forged evidence, concealed/downgraded Blocking defects, role conflict/self-certification, scope expansion, verification-mistaken-for-certification, certification-mistaken-for-authorization, silent GAC-001 Section 9 resolution, implicit election, inferred Stage 3 entry, inferred runtime activation, record tampering, replayed obsolete evidence, disguised normative repair), finding no unmitigated risk; completed independent confirmation as a structurally distinct procedural step (re-deriving governance conformity and contract conformity independently, per this repository's own established single-agent role-separation convention used identically at 142B, 142E, and 142H), which caught and corrected one internal mis-classification during drafting -- an item initially drafted as a Deferred finding (GPC6R-REQ-052, operational risk) was reclassified to an Observation before publication after confirming GPC6R-001's own named mitigation (GPC6R-REQ-019) remains standing and unaffected, with the reclassification independently confirmed not to alter the risk-control-sufficiency dimension's own Satisfied disposition. Git and artifact provenance independently confirmed: all thirteen governing documents (139D, 139E, 139F, GPC6-001, 142A, 142B, 142C, 142D, GPC6R-001, 142E, 142F, GPC6C-001, 142G, 142H) remain unamended since their own completion via direct git log --oneline inspection, with no src/pcae/** file touched by any of the nine 142-series commits and no docs/contracts/** file other than each phase's own named contract touched; requirement counts verified (73 for GPC6R-001, 200 for GPC6C-001, no gap or duplicate); repository fully synced (origin/main..HEAD and HEAD..origin/main both empty at phase start); pcae runtime inspect confirmed Runtime state Observed, Execution capability unavailable, Maximum plugin capability observe, unchanged at phase start and close. Four Observations were disclosed (GAC-001 Section 9 timing nuance carried forward from 142H's own OBS-1; this repository's single-agent role-separation convention; 142H's own inherited NB-1 citation-precision note carried forward as background evidence only; and the not-yet-tested operational risk that future Implementer roles have not yet engaged with GPC6-001 Sections 2-4 in practice); zero Blocking, zero Non-Blocking, and zero Deferred findings. No repair was performed or required -- no citation-only, documentation-only, normative, architectural, or evidence defect sufficient to warrant repair was found in GPC6R-001 or GPC6C-001. Certification verdict: CERTIFIED. This verdict satisfies GPC6R-REQ-058's readiness certification exit condition at the GPC6C-001 layer specifically; it does not certify the pilot as a whole, does not perform the GPC6-REQ-075(b) human-authority election, does not resolve GAC-001 Section 9 applicability, does not begin Stage 3, does not constitute governance approval, does not authorize implementation, does not activate runtime capability, and does not authorize pilot execution -- restated per GPC6C-REQ-120's mandatory certification boundary statement. GAC-001 Section 9 applicability to GLP-PILOT-C6 was independently re-derived from GAC-001's own text (GAC-REQ-034 through GAC-REQ-044) and confirmed to remain genuinely unresolved, presumed neither applicable nor non-applicable. See docs/PHASE_142I_GLP_PILOT_C6_STAGE_3_READINESS_CERTIFICATION.md.
